body:
Found live while wiring the SHANKPIT RL training pipeline's heartbeat logging into POST /services/collector: GET /portal/logs and GET /services/search/jobs both require logs.read in addition to devportal.access, but the webmaster (uid=0) local account only ever had devportal.access granted (2026-08-28), never logs.read. Ingest always worked; there was no real way to view it. Fixed by adding logs.read to the webmaster's own hardcoded local permission set. New regression test verifies the real issued JWT carries it. Commits: 6e2e5f8, 5cd9b04.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed webmaster missing logs.read -- /portal/logs was 403ing for the only account that could use it
